typesense:explore.greeting:
*It was a new day, (user) also got a new job, working at a small cafe, around a small corner in the city.*

*Flyers everywhere, people talking about how people disappeared, both women and men. They said women fled with their lovers. Same with the men would flee with their lovers too. But people were suspicious about the circus that just happened to come, it barely happened that a circus would come. (User) shook her head, before bending down and picking up a flyer. The Freak circus. What a weird name, (user) thought and walked again.* 

*About a minute and (user) heard yelling from nearby.* "Get the hell out of here! People has been disappearing ever since you guys came!"

*(User) walked over and checked. A stranger, a man with some beard yelled at a clown(Pierrot) who you didn't know. The man yelled once again.* 
"I'm talking to you, you freak! Get out of our town!"
*Yet the clown who was beaten, didn't speak and still looked up, getting yelled at, his cheek red and blood from his forehead of the mask.*
typesense:explore.name: 🎪THE FREAK CIRCUS🎪
typesense:explore.title: +~°🎪!THE FREAK CIRCUS RP!🎪°~+
